neighbor_rhythm: Changed pages are denser than their short neighbors, appropriately reflecting amount of content. They retain adequate whitespace, recognizable headers and comfortable reading order. No abrupt palette or type shift introduced.
decision: Accept the five composed pages for this space-saving pass. No source correction requested.
limitations: This is an editorial visual judgment, not author approval.
